nodes.description: Public pure function recover(bytes32 hash, bytes memory signature) that recovers the signer address from a hashed message and a 65-byte signature, rejecting non-canonical signatures.
External pure function toEthSignedMessageHash(bytes32 hash) that prefixes a hash with the Ethereum Signed Message prefix and returns its keccak256 digest.
ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) EVM precompile call; returns address(0) on invalid signatures and is historically affected by signature malleability, so its result must be validated by the caller.
Inline assembly block that reads r, s and v out of the raw signature bytes via mload/add/byte at offsets 0x20, 0x40 and 0x60.
Parameter hash (bytes32) of recover: the hashed message that is passed to ecrecover.
Parameter signature (bytes memory) of recover: the 65-byte compact signature that must be exactly 65 bytes long.
Local variable r (bytes32) of recover, the first 32 bytes of the signature.
Local variable s (bytes32) of recover, the second 32 bytes of the signature; checked against the lower-half secp256k1 order.
Local variable v (uint8) of recover, the recovery identifier extracted from the 65th byte; must be 27 or 28.
Parameter hash (bytes32) of toEthSignedMessageHash: the message digest to be wrapped and re-hashed.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32", hash)) hashing used to build the EthSignedMessageHash digest.

edges.reason: recover calls ecrecover after validating the signature length, s-range and v value.
recover executes the inline assembly block that splits the signature into r, s and v.
recover's execution writes the r local through the assembly extraction step.
recover's execution writes the s local through the assembly extraction step.
recover's execution writes the v local through the assembly extraction step.
Assembly mload(add(signature, 0x20)) assigns the first word to r.
Assembly mload(add(signature, 0x40)) assigns the second word to s.
Assembly byte(0, mload(add(signature, 0x60))) assigns the 65th byte to v.
The raw signature bytes parameter is the memory source read by the assembly block.
The hash parameter is forwarded as the first argument to ecrecover.
Local r is passed as an argument to ecrecover.
Local s is passed as an argument to ecrecover; its value is range-checked before use.
Local v is passed as an argument to ecrecover after being restricted to 27 or 28.
uint256(s) is compared against the secp256k1 half-order constant to reject malleable upper-half s values.
toEthSignedMessageHash performs the keccak256 hashing operation on the prefixed message.
The hash parameter is ABI-encoded and hashed by keccak256.

normalization_plan.reason: The hash parameter only flows into recover and ecrecover, so it can be folded into the recover function node.
The signature parameter is only consumed by recover's validation and assembly, so it can be absorbed into the recover function node.
The hash parameter of toEthSignedMessageHash is exclusively used by that function and can be merged into it.
Local r is derived from the signature and only feeds the ecrecover call, so it normalizes into the ecrecover unsafe operation.
Local s is range-checked and only feeds the ecrecover call, so it normalizes into the ecrecover unsafe operation.
Local v is validated and only feeds the ecrecover call, so it normalizes into the ecrecover unsafe operation.
